detail.longDescription: MakeUseOf: 55+ PDF tools fit inside this Docker container — my files never leave the house. “If you deal with sensitive PDF documents, you probably don’t want to use a tool that would send them to a third-party server over the internet. That makes self-hosted PDF apps a great alternative. Stirling PDF is one such tool. It packs over 50 PDF editing and management features into a single Docker […] https://rbfirehose.com/2026/09/01/makeuseof-55-pdf-tools-fit-inside-this-docker-container-my-files-never-leave-the-house/
